entities.summary: Cynan ap Hywel was a King of Gwynedd, one of the kingdoms or principalities of medieval Wales. He was the son of Hywel ab Ieuaf, a previous king from the line of Idwal Foel. On Hywel's death, the realm was ruled by his brother, but almost immediately was seized by Maredudd ab Owain.
